steps.en: Review pinned source and install hardware-matched dependencies in isolation
steps.zh: 审查固定源码，在隔离环境安装匹配硬件的依赖

steps.en: Launch, choose coordinator, identity and backend budget, then start training
steps.zh: 启动并选择协调器、身份、后端及内存预算，再开始训练

steps.en: Waits for a round and requests task metadata from the central coordinator
steps.zh: 等待轮次，向中央协调器申请任务元数据

steps.en: Downloads assigned model weights and token slices
steps.zh: 下载任务指定的模型权重和词元片段

steps.en: Trains locally; displays or logs loss, steps and remaining time locally
steps.zh: 执行本地训练，在本地显示或记录损失、步数和剩余时间

steps.en: Attempts to upload the compressed delta and final metadata, then logs the result
steps.zh: 尝试上传压缩差分和最终元数据，再记录提交结果

value.en: Contribute local compute to a shared experiment without operating a training cluster
value.zh: 无需自营训练集群，也能给共享实验贡献本机计算
